answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, we bind each agent to an orchard of recursive reputation commitments secured by staking collateral subject to slashing penalties. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay function creates a computational spiral preventing rapid identity cloning, as the cost of generating proofs outpaces the utility of any transient zephyr of influence. Consequently, this negative expected utility enforces a robust Nash equilibrium where identity spoofing yields zero economic incentive.
